versions.changelog:
- Initial release of sol-tool-spotlight.
- Weekly mini-reviews of AI tools actually used by Sol, including ratings, verdicts, and community context from dev.to.
- Automatically fetches dev.to discussions, generates a review using MiniMax, and posts as a Jekyll blog entry.
- Supports scheduled posting every Friday at 9am UK time.
- Requires MiniMax API key and access to a local Jekyll site repository.
